//: Builds the @vscode/test-electron suite under test/integration/ into out-integration/. Separate from tsconfig.json so nothing here can reach out/, which is the only directory .vscodeignore lets into the .vsix, and from tsconfig.test.json, which emits nothing and carries jest's types rather than mocha's. esModuleInterop is on here only, for mocha's `export =` default import; the extension itself compiles without it.
